html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 21, 2022

On Jul 13, 2022, full-stack digital marketing firm Tianji Chuangxiang (天际创想) (Beijing; founded Dec 2010) closed a ¥10M strategic from a domestic individual LP — for short-video IMC expansion and smart prospecting / precision marketing / IP builds across video platforms. Four pillars: tech outsourcing, ecom ops, investment attraction, marketing. 500+ case studies (Lenovo privilege, etc.); 100 premium clients; Youyou Group strategic partner since 2015. Platforms: Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu. Controller/CEO Zhou Dongxue.

— END —
